items.name: async-comboboxes
items.title: Async Comboboxes
items.description: Both async single- and multi-select comboboxes with search, infinite scrolling, and customizable content. Built with Base UI.
items.docs: Requires a Base UI shadcn/ui project, React with useEffectEvent, and Tailwind CSS 4 with a shadcn theme.
